name: Ghost Gate
details: Can create stable, two-way portals between any two locations she has memorized the precise coordinates of.

name: Amir Yaoyorozu
details: Subject can create unbreakable highly reflective invisible threads that can be wrapped around others to control them, or used to pull the user's body to locations where threads are attached.

name: Arthur Stormborne
details: Can create and manipulate black-colored electricity with unique properties distinct from standard electrical generation quirks. Exact differences under study.

name: Chiyo Shuuzenji
details: Allows the user to accelerate and amplify the target's healing process with a kiss, using the target's own stamina as fuel.
